# Wind Song Body Spray, Three-Pack: A Classic Floral Scent for Everyday Elegance

Wind Song Body Spray from Prince Matchabelli brings a time-honored, feminine fragrance to your daily routine. This three-pack includes three 2.5 oz. bottles, so you can keep one in your bag, one at home, and one ready for your next outing.

## A Light, Sweet Floral Scent

Soft floral and powdery notes create a clean, delicate fragrance with classic appeal. The light formula lets you wear it comfortably, so it complements your presence without overwhelming those around you.

## Fragrance for Every Occasion

Spritz on a light mist after your shower or before heading out. The gentle profile suits everything from daytime errands to evening plans, so you can refresh your scent whenever the day calls for it.

## Freshen More Than Yourself

Wind Song also works on clothing that has been sitting in a closet or drawer. A quick spray gives stored garments a fresh, pleasant finish.

## Stock Up on a Favorite

Three bottles for $18.95 give you a dependable supply of a beloved scent. Add the Wind Song Body Spray three-pack to your cart today and keep this classic fragrance within easy reach.
